channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Minneapolis grain silo for sale near the U a ‘long shot’ for redevelopment
item.description: Near Malcolm Yards and Huntington Bank Stadium, the site is in the right place but in major disrepair.

item.title: Reusse: Before the dramatic change in college basketball, you had to love Clem Haskins
item.description: Sports are all about characters, and the former Gophers basketball coach was a memorable one.

item.title: How Minnesota drivers can wipe their snow boogers this winter
item.description: It’s that time of year to ask: “Why is my car shaking when I accelerate?”

item.title: Sweden beats Switzerland, Finland blanks Latvia at World Junior tournament
item.description: Team USA returns to action on Monday and will play Slovakia at Grand Casino Arena at 5 p.m.

item.title: A season of uncertainty: Having weathered 2025 turbulence, a Minnesota farm family braces for 2026
item.description: There’s no end in sight to the instability created by President Donald Trump’s trade policies, and one analysis projects more challenges in the new year.

item.title: Minnesota Star Tribune closes Minneapolis printing plant as staff reflect on the end of an era
item.description: The closure of the Heritage Center comes as readers increasingly get their news online. The paper will now be printed in Iowa.

item.title: Gov. Tim Walz, Democrats tap influencers to spread political message
item.description: After Republicans outmaneuvered Democrats online in the 2024 election, Walz and fellow Democrats are trying to build their own network of content creators.

item.title: Gov. Walz calls National Guard, Minneapolis declares snow emergency as blizzard continues
item.description: Flights have been delayed and Interstate 35 closed to the south in Iowa as forecasters expect up to 10 inches in the east and hazardous travel statewide.
